lifecycle.redemption: caller-idempotent claim, consume, inactive identity, wallet, activation, finalization saga
lifecycle.reservation: account-free email uniqueness reservation before token consumption
lifecycle.json_atomicity: cross-process locked document mutations plus deterministic player identity
lifecycle.mysql_atomicity: document SELECT FOR UPDATE plus deterministic INSERT IGNORE player identity
lifecycle.terminal_retention: bounded cleanup after full configured retention

privacy.password: validated transiently and stored only through canonical password hashing
privacy.audit: opaque actor and invitation identifiers with fixed reasons
